cover.concept: A simple geometric filing box rendered in muted indigo sits on a flat shelf, its lid left slightly ajar; from the narrow gap a single warm accent-orange glow escapes, the only source of light in an otherwise flat, dim scene, as if something valuable has been sitting sealed inside and forgotten.

inline.name: consolidate-list
inline.concept: Three separate thin lines in muted indigo — one unspooling from a flat phone silhouette, one from an envelope shape, one from a small spiral notebook — each trailing a row of tiny dot-figures, converging and braiding together into a single thicker line that feeds into one open ledger shape glowing in accent orange, representing scattered contacts being gathered into one place.

inline.name: reactivation-signal
inline.concept: A flat horizontal line in muted indigo running level across the frame like a dormant signal, until partway across it suddenly spikes upward into a sharp bright accent-orange peak before leveling off again, with a faint row of small dot-figures beneath the flat section fading to grey and a few bright dot-figures glowing beneath the spike, capturing a quiet list waking up in one measurable moment.
